content.text: This is a phishing report - a classic case that must be escalated to the Security Team, not troubleshot.

input.reasoning_summary: Requester reports a phishing-style email asking to confirm password via link; this is a security incident requiring specialist handling, not a how-to fix.

summary.reported: Requester received an email purporting to be from 'IT Helpdesk' claiming their mailbox will be deleted unless they confirm their password via a link. They state they have not clicked the link.
summary.checked: Reviewed ticket details; no comments or prior history to review. This matches a typical phishing pattern (urgency, credential harvesting link, spoofed sender).
summary.ruled_out: Not a routine password reset or account request; not treated as a how-to knowledge-base fix.
summary.why_escalating: Unexpected emails asking to confirm or reset a password via a link are treated as phishing incidents per policy and must be handled by the Security Team, including checking headers, blocking/reporting the sender, and confirming no credentials were entered.
